name: Collective Intellect
body:
You can tap into the great zif collective to gain knowledge.

Prerequisite: Zif, Int 15, Wis 15.

Benefit: You gain a +2 racial bonus on all Knowledge-related skill checks that you do not have ranks in.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
